enabled.title: Enable the assistant
enabled.description: false switches the PII Review Assistant off on every page. Default: true.

defaultStage.title: Default stage
defaultStage.description: Stage shown to reviewers who have not picked one: L1 (Identify) or L2 (Verify). Default: L2.

pageSetup.title: Company-wide page setup
pageSetup.description: CSS selectors for the two task documents and the label spans, so reviewers do not have to set up the page. A reviewer's own saved setup still wins.

extraKnownNames.title: Extra known names
extraKnownNames.description: Public organisation names added to the built-in business names list (not PII; redacting one is over-scrubbing).

supportContact.title: Support contact
supportContact.description: Shown in the panel footer, e.g. an email address or a channel name.

model.title: On-device model
model.description: Model suggestions for names, companies, addresses and usernames (runs in the browser; text never leaves it). user: each reviewer decides in the extension options (default off). on: on for everyone. off: off for everyone. Default: user.
